clue.text: In old people's hostels, honesty reveals unpalatable facts

definitions.note: plural sense matches the plural answer

indicators.note: honesty is placed in the hostels, so the second word sits inside the first

parts.note: old people's homes are residential hostels for the elderly
honesty means truth

explanation.surface: In care homes for the elderly, candour brings uncomfortable realities to light.
explanation.definitionFit: Home truths are unwelcome facts about oneself that someone tells bluntly.

clue.text: Hear a male church choir?

indicators.note: asks the solver to listen, so the word for a male is taken by its sound

parts.note: a male person is referred to as him

explanation.surface: An invitation to listen to an all-male church choir.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is loose: what a church choir sings is a sacred song, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: A choir in church typically sings sacred songs of praise, the hymnal's contents.

clue.text: The quickest way to melt ripple?

explanation.surface: Wondering about the fastest method to melt ripple ice cream.
explanation.definitionFit: A kitchen oven using radiation defrosts food fastest; split into parts, a tiny undulation is a very small ripple.

clue.text: The course to follow

explanation.surface: A plain statement about which route to take.
explanation.definitionFit: A track is a course or path for racing; to track someone is to follow or trail them.

clue.text: How the price list goes, but anything on it is honest

explanation.surface: A wry remark that prices keep climbing, yet everything listed is genuine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On the up and up' is an idiom meaning honest and legitimate.
explanation.definitionFit: Prices rising steadily climb higher and higher; something on the level, legitimate, is said to be on this.

clue.text: Waste no time advising people impatient to reach the top

definitions.text: advising people impatient to reach the top

explanation.surface: A climbing party urging laggards to get a move on to the summit.
explanation.definitionFit: To rush is to make haste; the call telling people to go faster is also, literally, urging them upwards.

clue.text: Stone work assigned to a learner

parts.note: OP is short for opus, a musical work
L is a learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: Some masonry task given to an apprentice.
explanation.definitionFit: An opal is a precious gemstone showing iridescent colours.

clue.text: Implement for murder in which a gambler takes a hand

definitions.text: in which a gambler takes a hand

explanation.surface: A detective story where a gambler lends a hand with the killing weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: A fireside iron rod can serve as a murder weapon; it is also a card game where gamblers are dealt hands.

clue.text: It sounds like a low two-seater for the sybarite

indicators.note: the clue openly says the phrase is to be heard rather than read

parts.note: a low-slung sports car with two seats, said quickly

explanation.surface: A pleasure-lover's choice of car: a sleek, low sports two-seater.
explanation.walkthrough: In Homer's Odyssey the lotus-eaters lived in idle bliss, so the term means one devoted to indolent pleasure.
explanation.definitionFit: A sybarite is a self-indulgent pleasure-seeker, like those who ate the drug-like fruit in Homer and forgot home.

clue.text: Colonel goes up North to intercept Hitler's envoy in Scotland

indicators.note: in a down clue, going up means the abbreviation is read from bottom to top
the north sign cuts into the envoy's name, sitting inside it

parts.note: Rudolf Hess, Hitler's deputy, flew to Scotland in 1941 on a self-appointed peace mission
N is the compass abbreviation for north

explanation.surface: A colonel heads north to stop Rudolf Hess on his flight to Scotland.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue, 'goes up' reads the colonel's abbreviation bottom to top; 'to intercept' sets the compass letter inside the envoy's name. Hess really did fly to Scotland in 1941.
explanation.definitionFit: The famous lake of monster legend lies in the Scottish Highlands near Inverness.

clue.text: Health officer takes tea and coffee

parts.note: MO stands for Medical Officer, an officer responsible for health
cha is a slang word for tea

explanation.surface: A medical officer orders both tea and coffee.
explanation.definitionFit: Mocha is a fine coffee, originally shipped from the Yemeni port of that name.

clue.text: Kite or cap tossed up could be an aviation hazard

indicators.note: thrown into the air, the letters land in a new order

explanation.surface: A kite or a cap thrown skyward might endanger aircraft.
explanation.definitionFit: A region of turbulent or thinner air makes a plane drop suddenly, a known flying danger.

clue.text: Uninspiring advice to one who doesn't need a full week's employment

definitions.text: advice to one who doesn't need a full week's employment

explanation.surface: Dull counsel to a part-time worker.
explanation.definitionFit: Workaday means ordinary and humdrum; split up, it tells a part-timer to labour a single day.

clue.text: Staggered hours beloved of sun-worshippers

indicators.note: staggered hours are spread out, and here the word's letters reel into a new order

explanation.surface: Sunbathers love staggered working hours.
explanation.walkthrough: Horus was the falcon-headed Egyptian sky god linked with the sun, revered by ancient sun-worshippers.
explanation.definitionFit: The Egyptian falcon god was associated with the sun and venerated by its devotees.

clue.text: What the keen-eyed quarantine officer did for pudding

definitions.text: What the keen-eyed quarantine officer did

explanation.surface: A sharp-eyed quarantine officer catches an animal being smuggled in.
explanation.definitionFit: A sharp official noticed a hound; it is also a British steamed suet pudding studded with currants.

clue.text: Tax-free investment absorbing little money is a hot starter

indicators.note: the investment takes the money into itself, holding it inside

parts.note: a PEP, Personal Equity Plan, was a UK tax-free savings scheme
'a sou' is a trifling sum, the sou being an old French coin of low value

explanation.surface: A tax-exempt savings plan swallowing a small sum makes a warming first course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not a sou' means no money at all, so 'a sou' stands for a tiny amount.
explanation.definitionFit: A thick soup of split peas is served hot to begin a meal.

clue.text: "I'm going to choose one way that's sure to be right!"

definitions.text: "I'm going to choose one way that's sure to be right!"

indicators.note: the word I'm goes to the end of the word for choose, following it

parts.note: to opt is to choose
I is the Roman numeral one
ST is short for street, a way

explanation.surface: A cheerful person announcing whichever route they pick is bound to be correct.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone confident that things will always turn out well is a hopeful person.

clue.text: Palermo combine producing abundance

indicators.note: the letters of the city combine in a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A Sicilian conglomerate yields plenty.
explanation.definitionFit: Pleroma, from Greek, means fullness or plenitude, especially in theology.

clue.text: Where examinees write, though anything put on it may be ignored

definitions.text: anything put on it may be ignored

explanation.surface: Exam instructions about writing on a single face of the paper.
explanation.definitionFit: Exam rules say use one face of the sheet; to set something aside is to put it there.

clue.text: The highest leaves a Rock-a bye baby on it

definitions.text: a Rock-a bye baby on it

explanation.surface: Recalling the nursery rhyme cradle perched among the topmost leaves.
explanation.definitionFit: The crown of a tree bears the uppermost foliage; the lullaby begins 'Rock-a-bye baby, on the' it.

clue.text: Suggest a professional attitude

parts.note: pro is short for professional
a pose is a bodily attitude or posture

explanation.surface: Recommend a businesslike stance.
explanation.definitionFit: To propose is to put forward a plan or idea for consideration.

clue.text: Steam yacht moved silently as a heartbeat

parts.note: stole means crept quietly

explanation.surface: A steam-powered yacht glided quietly along like a pulse.
explanation.definitionFit: Systole is the contraction phase of each cardiac cycle, pumping the blood.

clue.text: Bone hard murmur of doubt

parts.note: stern means hard or severe
um is a hesitant, doubtful murmur

explanation.surface: A hard-boned skeleton prompts a doubtful mumble.
explanation.definitionFit: The sternum is the breastbone in the middle of the chest.

clue.text: Computer chip providing key to an Albert Hall concert

parts.note: E is a musical key
the Proms are summer concerts held at London's Royal Albert Hall

explanation.surface: A microchip that unlocks entry to a London concert.
explanation.definitionFit: An EPROM is an erasable programmable read-only memory device in electronics.

clue.text: He's in spirit despite a cold

indicators.note: the pronoun is placed in the drink, inside it

parts.note: rum is a spirit
the pronoun he; 's is read as 'is'

explanation.surface: He's drinking spirits even though he has a chill.
explanation.definitionFit: Rheum is watery discharge from the nose or eyes, as with a common chill.

clue.text: Biased description of a Möbius band

explanation.surface: A partial account of a twisted strip of paper.
explanation.definitionFit: Partial or unfair; a Möbius strip has only a single surface.

clue.text: Inter formally when declared lifeless

indicators.note: read as giving the word a new form, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Burial follows formally once someone is pronounced dead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'formally' is an unusual anagram signal: the five letters are put into another form. 'when declared' is link.
explanation.definitionFit: Inert means motionless and lacking the power to act.

definitions.text: discount is available in the fashion shop!

explanation.surface: A shopper scolded while bargains are on in a clothes boutique.
explanation.definitionFit: To reprimand someone sharply; split up, it says frocks are reduced in price.

clue.text: The type one meets in the best circles

definitions.text: one meets in the best circles

explanation.surface: The kind of person encountered in high society.
explanation.walkthrough: Elite is also a typewriter typeface size, twelve characters to the inch.
explanation.definitionFit: A typewriter font of small size; also the select upper group of society.

clue.text: Lame duck?

explanation.surface: Asking about a duck that cannot walk properly.
explanation.definitionFit: A game leg is an injured one; wild birds hunted for sport, such as ducks, are quarry.

clue.text: She knows about the strain joined fabric is subject to

definitions.text: She knows about the strain joined fabric is subject to

parts.words: She knows about the strain joined fabric is subject to
parts.note: the stress on a sewn join is a seam's strain, and the woman who sews knows all about it

explanation.surface: A woman expert in how stitched material bears tension.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman who sews garments professionally understands how stitched joins bear load.
